title: 第151章 第三期录制
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

海城，寸土寸金的魔都。

这是一座欧式庄园，占地足足三千平米。

光是从大门走到主楼就要五分钟。

喷泉、雕塑、修剪得一丝不苟的法式花园。

每一处细节都透着金钱的味道。

吴凡估计这座庄园的价值，差不多够在其他城市买下一栋楼了。

可就是这么一座庄园的，吴凡一个电话过去，对方不仅分文不收，还非常客气。

吴凡原先是想把庄园租一天下来，用来录制节目。

只是联系上对方之后，还没等他问价格，就被对方就打断了。

“吴导要拍节目，那是给我面子，谈钱就生分了！以后咱们就是朋友，有空常来坐坐，这个庄园我平时也不住，就交给吴导你了！”

吴凡当时听着电话那头云淡风轻的语气，心里只有一个念头。

这就是顶级富豪的社交方式吗？

免费借个庄园，就跟说着玩似的。

不过吴凡内心也明白，这种级别的富豪，在国内肯定是手眼通天的人物。

而关于自己的信息，肯定早就放在他们的桌子上了。

吴凡虽然不知道系统到底有多牛，但很显然这些人都是被唬住了。

一个拥有神秘背景的年轻导演，纵然是这些顶级富豪也不愿意招惹。

对他们来说钱只是一个数字，远不如一个人情来的重要。

于是，这座从未对公众开放的私人庄园，成了《奔跑吧初代》和《极限挑战》联合特辑的拍摄地。

而且免费！

此刻庄园主楼的化妆间里，十六个人正在紧锣密鼓地换装。

没有人知道今天要拍什么。

吴凡是没有提前透露半句关于录制的内容。

只让工作人员给每个人送去了一套西装。

这可不是普通的西装。

全都是量身定制的。

每一件都贴在身上肩线刚好，腰身刚好，连袖口的长度都分毫不差。

西装就是要这样，尺寸必须要恰到好处。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Haicheng, a magical city where every inch of land is valuable.

This is a European-style manor covering an area of ​​3,000 square meters.

Just walking from the main gate to the main building takes five minutes.

Fountains, sculptures, meticulously manicured French gardens.

Every detail smells like money.

Wu Fan estimated that the value of this manor was almost enough to buy a building in other cities.

But it was such a manor. When Wu Fan called, the other party not only refused to accept any money, but was also very polite.

Wu Fan originally wanted to rent the manor for a day to record programs.

But after contacting the other party, he was interrupted before he could ask the price.

"Director Wu wants to film a show, it's just to give me face, and we're talking about money! We'll be friends from now on, and we'll come here often when we have time. I don't usually live in this manor, so I'll leave it to you, Director Wu!"

Wu Fan listened to the gentle tone on the other end of the phone and had only one thought in his mind.

Is this how the top rich socialize?

Borrowing a manor for free is just a joke.

However, Wu Fan also understood in his heart that a rich man of this level must be a person with powerful eyes and hands in China.

And the information about yourself must have been on their desks for a long time.

Although Wu Fan didn't know how powerful the system was, it was obvious that these people were fooled.

A young director with a mysterious background, even these top rich people are not willing to mess with him.

To them, money is just a number, far less important than a favor.

As a result, this private estate, which has never been open to the public, became the filming location for the joint special series of "The First Generation of Running" and "Extreme Challenge".

And it’s free!

At this moment, in the dressing room of the main building of the manor, sixteen people were changing clothes in full swing.

No one knows what to shoot today.

Wu Fan did not reveal anything about the recording in advance.

I just asked the staff to give each person a suit.

This is no ordinary suit.

All made to measure.

Each piece fits the body with just the right shoulder line, the right waist, and even the length of the cuffs.

That's the thing with suits, the size has to be just right.
